                                        ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current Bl-2, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 13-J in the area bounded by:

              the public alley next north of and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; a line 108.2
              feet east of and parallel to North Central Park Avenue; West Lawrence Avenue;
              and a line 83.2 feet east of and parallel to North Central Park Avenue

to those of an B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 3548 West Lawrence Avenue
                                      CITY OF CHICAGO
